props.animation_script:
// ============================================================================

//

// Zero Power: Rebellion Wing (Foundry VTT v12) — POLISHED v3

//

// Updates in this version:

// 1) New form scaling changed to 1.38

// 2) After swapping to new form: start an idle floating (levitation) loop on the sprite

// - easing in/out

// - persists (NO cleanup) until you remove sprite later

//

// Multi-client sync update (FULL):

// - Cut-in portrait overlay ALSO runs via Pseudo Animation API (broadcast to all clients)

// - Persistent screen darkener ALSO runs via Pseudo Animation API (broadcast to all clients)

// - Camera pan is also moved into the same pseudo phase so every client pans consistently

// - The pseudo battler sprite sequence remains broadcast as before

//

// Notes:

// - TokenDocument alpha updates + flags remain GM-authoritative outside pseudo scripts

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][ZeroPower][RebellionWing]";

// -----------------------------

// Assets

// -----------------------------

const CUTIN_URL =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Campaign/The%20Legend%20of%20Dragonslayer/Image/NPCs/Kalina/Kalina_Cut-In.png";

const CUTIN_SFX_URL =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/BurstMax.ogg";

const ENERGY_VFX =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Energy/EnergyStrandIN01_02_Regular_Green_600x600.webm";

const ENERGY_SFX =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/ChargingA.wav";

const IMPACT_VFX =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Energy/EnergyStrandIN01_02_Regular_Green_600x600.webm";

const IMPACT_SFX =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/ExecutionGET.wav";

const BATTler_WEBM =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Campaign/The%20Legend%20of%20Dragonslayer/Image/NPCs/Kalina/Kalina_Battler002.webm";

// -----------------------------

// Helpers (general)

// -----------------------------

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, Math.max(0, ms)));

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) => {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

}

function resolveCasterToken() {

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const uuid =

p.casterTokenUuid ||

p.attackerTokenUuid ||

p.attacker_token_uuid ||

p.attackerTokenUUID ||

p.sourceTokenUuid ||

null;

if (uuid && typeof fromUuidSync === "function") {

const doc = fromUuidSync(uuid);

const t = doc?.object;

if (t) return t;

}

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

async function resolveCasterTokenAsync() {

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const uuid =

p.casterTokenUuid ||

p.attackerTokenUuid ||

p.attacker_token_uuid ||

p.attackerTokenUUID ||

p.sourceTokenUuid ||

null;

if (uuid) {

try {

const doc = await fromUuid(uuid);

return doc?.object ?? null;

} catch (_) {}

}

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

// -----------------------------

// Main

// -----------------------------

let sourceToken = null;

let runId = null;

try {

if (!game?.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {

ui.notifications.error("ONI Pseudo Animation API not found: game.ONI.pseudo.play");

return;

}

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

return;

}

if (!canvas?.ready) {

ui.notifications.warn("Canvas is not ready yet.");

return;

}

sourceToken = resolveCasterToken() ?? (await resolveCasterTokenAsync());

if (!sourceToken) {

ui.notifications.warn("No caster token found (select a token or provide __PAYLOAD caster uuid).");

return;

}

runId = `${Date.now()}-${foundry.utils.randomID(6)}`;

const dimKey = `rebellionWing:${sourceToken.id}`;

console.log(TAG, "START", {

runId,

caster: { id: sourceToken.id, name: sourceToken.name, uuid: sourceToken.document.uuid },

dimKey

});

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationStart",

{

type: "zeroPower.rebellionWing",

runId,

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

sourceTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

// =========================================================================

// PHASE A (Pseudo Broadcast): Cut-in overlay + CameraPan + Start Persistent Dimmer

// =========================================================================

const phaseA = `

const TAG = "[ONI][Pseudo][RebellionWing][PhaseA]";

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

if (!canvas?.ready) throw new Error("Canvas not ready");

const wait = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.max(0, ms)));

const CUTIN_URL = String(params.cutinUrl);

const CUTIN_SFX_URL = String(params.cutinSfxUrl);

const dimKey = String(params.dimKey);

// --- Cut-in config (EXACT values) ---

const cfg = {

delayMs: 0,

dimAlpha: 0.6,

dimFadeMs: 200,

flashPeak: 0.9,

flashDelayMs: 60,

flashInMs: 70,

flashOutMs: 180,

slideInMs: 650,

holdMs: 900,

slideOutMs: 650,

portraitHeightRatio: 0.9,

portraitInsetX: 220,

portraitBottomMargin: 40,

portraitYOffset: -140,

sfxVol: 0.9,

};

// easing

const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

const easeInCubic = (t) => t * t * t;

const easeOutQuad = (t) => 1 - (1 - t) * (1 - t);

const easeInQuad = (t) => t * t;

function tween(obj, prop, from, to, ms, ease = easeOutQuad) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const dur = Math.max(1, Number(ms) || 1);

const start = performance.now();

obj[prop] = from;

const step = (now) => {

const t = Math.min(1, (now - start) / dur);

obj[prop] = from + (to - from) * ease(t);

if (t < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);

else resolve();

};

requestAnimationFrame(step);

});

}

function tweenXY(obj, xFrom, xTo, yFrom, yTo, ms, ease = easeOutQuad) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const dur = Math.max(1, Number(ms) || 1);

const start = performance.now();

obj.x = xFrom; obj.y = yFrom;

const step = (now) => {

const t = Math.min(1, (now - start) / dur);

const k = ease(t);

obj.x = xFrom + (xTo - xFrom) * k;

obj.y = yFrom + (yTo - yFrom) * k;

if (t < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);

else resolve();

};

requestAnimationFrame(step);

});

}

function tweenCombo(items) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const start = performance.now();

for (const it of items) it.obj[it.prop] = it.from;

const step = (now) => {

let done = true;

for (const it of items) {

const ms = Math.max(1, Number(it.ms) || 1);

const t = Math.min(1, (now - start) / ms);

const k = (it.ease || easeOutQuad)(t);

it.obj[it.prop] = it.from + (it.to - it.from) * k;

if (t < 1) done = false;

}

if (!done) requestAnimationFrame(step);

else resolve();

};

requestAnimationFrame(step);

});

}

async function loadTexture(src) {

const fn = foundry?.utils?.preloadTexture ?? globalThis.loadTexture;

if (typeof fn === "function") return await fn(src);

if (PIXI?.Assets?.load) return await PIXI.Assets.load(src);

return PIXI.Texture.from(src);

}

async function playSfx(url, volume = 0.9) {

try {

if (globalThis.AudioHelper?.play) {

await AudioHelper.play({ src: url, volume, autoplay: true, loop: false }, true);

return;

}

} catch (e) {

console.warn(TAG, "AudioHelper.play failed, falling back:", e);

}

try {

const a = new Audio(url);

a.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volume));

await a.play();

} catch (e) {

console.warn(TAG, "HTMLAudio play failed:", e);

}

}

// --- Persistent dimmer map (client-side) ---

globalThis.__ONI_DIMMERS = globalThis.__ONI_DIMMERS ?? new Map();

function startPersistentScreenDimmer({ alpha = 0.6, fadeMs = 250, key } = {}) {

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

// if already exists, destroy first (safety)

try {

const old = globalThis.__ONI_DIMMERS.get(key);

if (old) old.destroy({ children: true });

} catch (_) {}

const c = new PIXI.Container();

c.name = \`oni-dimmer-\${key}\`;

c.zIndex = 1;

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.beginFill(0x000000, 1).drawRect(0, 0, W, H).endFill();

g.alpha = 0;

c.addChild(g);

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(c);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

const start = performance.now();

const dur = Math.max(1, fadeMs);

const tick = () => {

const t = Math.min(1, (performance.now() - start) / dur);

g.alpha = alpha * t;

if (t >= 1) canvas.app.ticker.remove(tick);

};

canvas.app.ticker.add(tick);

globalThis.__ONI_DIMMERS.set(key, c);

return c;

}

let overlay = null;

try {

// ---------------------------

// A1) Cut-in overlay (portrait + flash + dim) (client-side PIXI)

// ---------------------------

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

overlay = new PIXI.Container();

overlay.zIndex = 999999;

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(overlay);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

const dim = new PIXI.Graphics();

dim.beginFill(0x000000, 1).drawRect(0, 0, W, H).endFill();

dim.alpha = 0;

const flash = new PIXI.Graphics();

flash.beginFill(0xffffff, 1).drawRect(0, 0, W, H).endFill();

flash.alpha = 0;

overlay.addChild(dim, flash);

await tween(dim, "alpha", 0, cfg.dimAlpha, cfg.dimFadeMs, easeOutQuad);

const tex = await loadTexture(CUTIN_URL);

const texture = tex instanceof PIXI.Texture ? tex : PIXI.Texture.from(CUTIN_URL);

const portrait = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

portrait.anchor.set(0, 1);

overlay.addChild(portrait);

const targetH = H * cfg.portraitHeightRatio;

const scale = targetH / portrait.texture.height;

portrait.scale.set(scale);

const finalX = cfg.portraitInsetX;

const finalY = (H - cfg.portraitBottomMargin) + (cfg.portraitYOffset ?? 0);

const startX = -portrait.width - 80;

portrait.x = startX;

portrait.y = finalY;

portrait.alpha = 1;

await wait(cfg.flashDelayMs);

await tween(flash, "alpha", 0, cfg.flashPeak, cfg.flashInMs, easeOutQuad);

const flashFadePromise = tween(flash, "alpha", flash.alpha, 0, cfg.flashOutMs, easeInQuad);

playSfx(CUTIN_SFX_URL, cfg.sfxVol).catch(() => {});

await tweenXY(portrait, portrait.x, finalX, portrait.y, finalY, cfg.slideInMs, easeOutCubic);

await flashFadePromise;

await wait(cfg.holdMs);

const exitX = W + 40;

await Promise.all([

tween(dim, "alpha", dim.alpha, 0, 180, easeInQuad),

tweenCombo([

{ obj: portrait, prop: "x", from: portrait.x, to: exitX, ms: cfg.slideOutMs, ease: easeInCubic },

{ obj: portrait, prop: "alpha", from: 1, to: 0, ms: cfg.slideOutMs, ease: easeInQuad },

]),

]);

} catch (e) {

console.warn(TAG, "Cut-in overlay failed (non-fatal):", e);

} finally {

try {

if (overlay) overlay.destroy({ children: true, texture: false, baseTexture: false });

} catch (_) {}

}

// ---------------------------

// A2) Camera pan (Sequencer) - now inside pseudo so all clients pan

// ---------------------------

try {

if (game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active && casterToken) {

await new Sequence()

.canvasPan()

.centerOn(casterToken)

.duration(600)

.ease("easeInOutCubic")

.play();

}

} catch (e) {

console.warn(TAG, "CanvasPan failed (continuing):", e);

}

// ---------------------------

// A3) Start persistent dimmer (client-side PIXI) - now synced across all clients

// ---------------------------

startPersistentScreenDimmer({ alpha: 0.6, fadeMs: 200, key: dimKey });

console.log(TAG, "PhaseA DONE", { dimKey });

`;

const phaseAResult = game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "zeroPower.rebellionWing.phaseA",

scriptSource: phaseA,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [],

params: {

cutinUrl: CUTIN_URL,

cutinSfxUrl: CUTIN_SFX_URL,

dimKey,

},

meta: { source: "Zero Power: Rebellion Wing (Phase A)" },

});

if (phaseAResult && typeof phaseAResult.then === "function") await phaseAResult;

else await wait(650 + 900 + 650 + 600 + 250); // conservative fallback

// 4) Real token alpha = 0 (persist) - GM authoritative

await sourceToken.document.update({ alpha: 0 });

// 5) Store flag (for later cleanup macro)

await sourceToken.document.setFlag("fabula-ultima-companion", "rebellionWing", {

runId,

spriteKey: runId,

dimmerKey: dimKey,

createdAt: Date.now(),

note:

"Persistent Rebellion Wing sprite is stored client-side in __ONI_RW_SPRITES map by runId.",

});

// =========================================================================

// PHASE B (Pseudo Broadcast): Persistent battler sprite sequence (unchanged logic)

// =========================================================================

const phaseB = `

const TAG = "[ONI][Pseudo][RebellionWing][PhaseB]";

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Need casterToken");

const wait = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.max(0, ms)));

globalThis.__ONI_RW_SPRITES = globalThis.__ONI_RW_SPRITES ?? new Map();

globalThis.__ONI_RW_SPRITES_BY_TOKEN = globalThis.__ONI_RW_SPRITES_BY_TOKEN ?? new Map();

globalThis.__ONI_RW_FLOATERS = globalThis.__ONI_RW_FLOATERS ?? new Map();

const RUN_ID = String(params.runId);

const ENERGY_VFX = String(params.energyVfx);

const ENERGY_SFX = String(params.energySfx);

const IMPACT_VFX = String(params.impactVfx);

const IMPACT_SFX = String(params.impactSfx);

const BATTler_WEBM = String(params.battlerWebm);

const jumpHeight = Number(params.jumpHeight ?? 90);

const jumpUpMs = Number(params.jumpUpMs ?? 220);

const holdMs = Number(params.holdMs ?? 420);

const tintFadeMs = Number(params.tintFadeMs ?? 900);

const impactDelayMs = Number(params.impactDelayMs ?? 1700);

const newFormScale = Number(params.newFormScale ?? 1.38);

const impactTintRestoreMs = Number(params.impactTintRestoreMs ?? 250);

// Idle floating config (persistent)

const floatAmp = Number(params.floatAmp ?? 10);

const floatPeriodMs = Number(params.floatPeriodMs ?? 1400);

const floatEaseInMs = Number(params.floatEaseInMs ?? 350);

function easeOutCubic(t){ return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3); }

function easeInOutCubic(t){ return t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2; }

function clamp01(x){ return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, x)); }

function animateXY(obj, from, to, durMs, easeFn){

return new Promise(resolve => {

const dur = Math.max(1, durMs);

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / dur;

const t = clamp01(raw);

const k = (easeFn || easeInOutCubic)(t);

obj.x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * k;

obj.y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * k;

if (t >= 1) { ticker.remove(update); resolve(); }

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

function tweenTint(sprite, fromRGB, toRGB, durMs){

return new Promise(resolve => {

const dur = Math.max(1, durMs);

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / dur;

const t = clamp01(raw);

const k = easeInOutCubic(t);

const r = Math.round(fromRGB.r + (toRGB.r - fromRGB.r) * k);

const g = Math.round(fromRGB.g + (toRGB.g - fromRGB.g) * k);

const b = Math.round(fromRGB.b + (toRGB.b - fromRGB.b) * k);

sprite.tint = (r << 16) + (g << 8) + b;

if (t >= 1) { ticker.remove(update); resolve(); }

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

function tweenTintToBlack(sprite, durMs){

return tweenTint(sprite, {r:255,g:255,b:255}, {r:0,g:0,b:0}, durMs);

}

function tweenTintToNormal(sprite, durMs){

const cur = sprite.tint ?? 0x000000;

const from = { r: (cur >> 16) & 0xFF, g: (cur >> 8) & 0xFF, b: cur & 0xFF };

return tweenTint(sprite, from, {r:255,g:255,b:255}, durMs);

}

async function safeLoadTexture(src){

try {

const t = await loadTexture(src);

return t instanceof PIXI.Texture ? t : PIXI.Texture.from(src);

} catch (e) {

console.warn(TAG, "loadTexture failed:", src, e);

return PIXI.Texture.from(src);

}

}

async function createClone(token){

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const tex = baseObj?.texture ?? await safeLoadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

sprite.x = token.center.x;

sprite.y = token.center.y;

if (baseObj) { sprite.width = baseObj.width; sprite.height = baseObj.height; }

sprite.zIndex = 999999;

// Always flip horizontally

const sx = Math.abs(sprite.scale.x || 1);

const sy = Math.abs(sprite.scale.y || 1);

sprite.scale.set(-sx, sy);

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

return sprite;

}

function locFromSprite(sprite){

return { x: sprite.x, y: sprite.y };

}

async function ensureVideoPlays(sprite){

try {

const res = sprite.texture?.baseTexture?.resource;

const vid = res?.source;

if (vid instanceof HTMLVideoElement) {

vid.loop = true;

vid.muted = true;

vid.playsInline = true;

await vid.play().catch(() => {});

return;

}

if (typeof res?.play === "function") res.play();

if ("autoPlay" in (res ?? {})) res.autoPlay = true;

} catch (e) {

console.warn(TAG, "ensureVideoPlays failed:", e);

}

}

// Start an idle floating animation loop on the sprite (persists, no cleanup)

function startIdleFloat(sprite){

try {

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const baseY = sprite.y;

const start = performance.now();

const update = () => {

if (!sprite || sprite.destroyed) {

ticker.remove(update);

return;

}

const now = performance.now();

const elapsed = now - start;

const phase = (elapsed % floatPeriodMs) / floatPeriodMs; // 0..1

const sin = Math.sin(phase * Math.PI * 2);

const inT = clamp01(elapsed / floatEaseInMs);

const inK = easeInOutCubic(inT);

sprite.y = baseY + sin * floatAmp * inK;

};

globalThis.__ONI_RW_FLOATERS.set(RUN_ID, { ticker, update });

ticker.add(update);

} catch (e) {

console.warn(TAG, "startIdleFloat failed:", e);

}

}

console.log(TAG, "START", { runId: RUN_ID, caster: { id: casterToken.id, name: casterToken.name } });

let sprite = null;

try {

sprite = await createClone(casterToken);

sprite.name = "oni-rebellionWing-sprite";

globalThis.__ONI_RW_SPRITES.set(RUN_ID, sprite);

globalThis.__ONI_RW_SPRITES_BY_TOKEN.set(casterToken.document.uuid, RUN_ID);

// Jump + hold

const home = { x: sprite.x, y: sprite.y };

const apex = { x: home.x, y: home.y - jumpHeight };

await animateXY(sprite, home, apex, jumpUpMs, easeOutCubic);

if (holdMs > 0) await wait(holdMs);

// Energy VFX + tint to black (Sequencer timing is synced by pseudo)

new Sequence()

.sound().file(ENERGY_SFX).volume(0.9)

.effect().file(ENERGY_VFX).atLocation(locFromSprite(sprite)).scale(2).opacity(1.0)

.play();

const tintToBlackPromise = tweenTintToBlack(sprite, tintFadeMs);

// Wait before impact

await wait(impactDelayMs);

// Impact moment: VFX/SFX + restore tint

const impactSeqPromise = new Sequence()

.sound().file(IMPACT_SFX).volume(0.9)

.effect().file(IMPACT_VFX).atLocation(locFromSprite(sprite)).scale(2).opacity(1.0)

.play();

const tintRestorePromise = tweenTintToNormal(sprite, impactTintRestoreMs);

await Promise.allSettled([impactSeqPromise, tintRestorePromise, tintToBlackPromise]);

// Swap to battler webm

const newTex = await safeLoadTexture(BATTler_WEBM);

sprite.texture = newTex;

// New form scale = 1.38 (keep flip)

const base = Math.abs(sprite.scale.x || 1);

const s = base * newFormScale;

sprite.scale.set(-s, s);

await ensureVideoPlays(sprite);

// Start idle levitation loop AFTER transformation

startIdleFloat(sprite);

console.log(TAG, "DONE (no cleanup) runId=", RUN_ID);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "FAILED:", err);

ui.notifications?.error?.(\`Rebellion Wing pseudo failed: \${err?.message ?? err}\`);

throw err;

}

`;

const expectedMs = 220 + 250 + 1700 + 650;

const phaseBResult = game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "zeroPower.rebellionWing.phaseB",

scriptSource: phaseB,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [],

params: {

runId,

jumpHeight: 90,

jumpUpMs: 220,

holdMs: 250,

tintFadeMs: 900,

impactDelayMs: 1700,

newFormScale: 1.38,

impactTintRestoreMs: 250,

// idle float tuning

floatAmp: 10,

floatPeriodMs: 1400,

floatEaseInMs: 350,

// assets

energyVfx: ENERGY_VFX,

energySfx: ENERGY_SFX,

impactVfx: IMPACT_VFX,

impactSfx: IMPACT_SFX,

battlerWebm: BATTler_WEBM,

},

meta: { source: "Zero Power: Rebellion Wing (Phase B)" },

});

if (phaseBResult && typeof phaseBResult.then === "function") await phaseBResult;

else await wait(expectedMs);

// =========================================================================

// PHASE C (Pseudo Broadcast): Fade out + remove persistent dimmer on ALL clients

// =========================================================================

const phaseC = `

const TAG = "[ONI][Pseudo][RebellionWing][PhaseC]";

const { params } = ctx;

const wait = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.max(0, ms)));

const dimKey = String(params.dimKey);

const ms = Number(params.ms ?? 350);

globalThis.__ONI_DIMMERS = globalThis.__ONI_DIMMERS ?? new Map();

async function fadeOutAndRemoveDimmer(key, ms = 300) {

try {

const map = globalThis.__ONI_DIMMERS;

const c = map?.get(key);

if (!c) return;

const g = c.children?.[0];

if (!g) {

c.destroy({ children: true });

map.delete(key);

return;

}

const from = g.alpha ?? 0;

const start = performance.now();

const dur = Math.max(1, ms);

await new Promise((resolve) => {

const tick = () => {

const t = Math.min(1, (performance.now() - start) / dur);

g.alpha = from * (1 - t);

if (t >= 1) {

canvas.app.ticker.remove(tick);

resolve();

}

};

canvas.app.ticker.add(tick);

});

c.destroy({ children: true });

map.delete(key);

} catch (e) {

console.warn("[ONI][Dimmer] cleanup failed:", e);

}

}

await fadeOutAndRemoveDimmer(dimKey, ms);

console.log(TAG, "Dimmer removed", { dimKey });

`;

const phaseCResult = game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "zeroPower.rebellionWing.phaseC",

scriptSource: phaseC,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [],

params: { dimKey, ms: 350 },

meta: { source: "Zero Power: Rebellion Wing (Phase C)" },

});

if (phaseCResult && typeof phaseCResult.then === "function") await phaseCResult;

else await wait(400);

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationEnd",

{

type: "zeroPower.rebellionWing",

runId,

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

sourceTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

console.log(TAG, "END (sprite persists, token alpha persists, dimmer cleaned on all clients)");

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "CRASHED:", err);

try {

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationEnd",

{

type: "zeroPower.rebellionWing",

runId: runId ?? null,

error: true,

message: err?.message ?? String(err),

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

} catch (_) {}

ui.notifications.error(`Rebellion Wing crashed: ${err?.message ?? err}`);

}

})();
